heroSummary: At Arvion, sustainability is not an afterthought or compliance checkbox—it is the foundational engineering constraint under which every molecule, fiber, and pressure vessel is conceived.

keyPillars.title: Industrial Water Neutrality & ZLD
keyPillars.description: Through multi-stage mechanical vapor recompression and forward osmosis, our zero liquid discharge installations eliminate polluted effluent completely.
keyPillars.targetYear: Current Reality across 100% of wet processing sites
initiatives: 75 Million liters of industrial water recycled every 24 hours
Rainwater catchment reservoirs storing 4.2 million cubic meters across industrial parks
Zero freshwater extraction in regions classified as water-stressed

keyPillars.title: Renewable Energy Transition
keyPillars.description: Dedicated captive rooftop solar arrays and long-term wind power purchase agreements power our spinning, weaving, and heavy fabrication bays.
initiatives: 78 MW combined solar and wind captive generation capacity
Biomass steam boilers fueled exclusively by agricultural waste and briquettes
Smart factory load balancing reducing peak grid draw by 22%

keyPillars.title: Clean Chemistry & Safe Inputs
keyPillars.description: Rigorous chemical management eliminating restricted substances, alkylphenols, and toxic heavy metals from all dye recipes and coatings.
initiatives: OEKO-TEX Standard 100 Class I certification across 100% of finished textiles
BlueSign® system partner for technical finishing chemicals
Enzymatic bio-scouring eliminating caustic soda from preparatory baths

keyPillars.title: Material Circularity & Zero Waste to Landfill
keyPillars.description: Transforming industrial byproducts into raw materials for construction, agriculture, and recycled yarn production.
keyPillars.targetYear: Zero Waste to Landfill across all plants by 2028
initiatives: Recovered sodium sulfate reused directly in local detergent and glass industries
Combed cotton spinning waste recycled back into denim yarns
Sludge co-processing in cement kilns substituting fossil fuels

waterStewardship.summary: Every droplet used in our dyeing and finishing processes is purified, desalinated, and returned to the boilers, closing the water loop entirely.
